request.style: English, Nigerian highlife praise, a church band with bright guitars, trumpets and saxophone, talking drum and shekere, a female lead and a big call-and-response choir, joyous dancing, 118 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Make a joyful noise to the Lord, all the earth
Serve the Lord with gladness
Come before his presence with singing
Know that the Lord, he is God

[Chorus]
Enter his gates with thanksgiving
And his courts with praise
Give thanks to him, bless his name
Give thanks to him, bless his name

[Verse]
It is he who made us, and we are his
We are his people, the sheep of his pasture
For the Lord is good, his love endures forever
His faithfulness to all generations

[Chorus]
Enter his gates with thanksgiving
And his courts with praise
Give thanks to him, bless his name
Give thanks to him, bless his name
